requirement:
In the combined gaps overview, clicking a listed file MUST expand or collapse
its uncovered obligations in place. Each expanded file MUST show each
obligation's source item and source location, measurement, and explanation
status.
rationale:
The subject has three obligations. Clicking a listed file expands and collapses its uncovered obligations in place. Each expanded file shows each obligation's source item and source location. Each also shows its measurement and explanation status. The marked test `src/execution_coverage/check.rs#mod[tests]/fn[book_verdict_and_gaps_follow_the_native_policy_and_current_reviews]` covers all three. - **Expand and collapse in place:** The test calls the helper `exercise_file_click` on the rendered HTML, both for the missing-review case and the below-target case. The helper takes the real `onclick`, `aria-controls` and row ids from the HTML. It runs the handler in Node with stubbed DOM objects. It asserts that the first click un-hides the generated detail row, sets `aria-expanded` to true and changes the chevron to ▾. It asserts that the second click re-hides the row, sets `aria-expanded` back to false and restores ▸. The test also checks that the detail rows start `hidden` and that the button has `aria-expanded="false"`. The rows are in the same page, so the expansion is in place. - **Source item and location:** The unresolved-gaps table rows are asserted to contain `fn[a]` with `code.rs:1`, and `fn[b]` with `code.rs:5`. In the below-target scenario, the file-level obligation is asserted as `File root` with `code.rs:1`, and the `fn[a]` and `fn[b]` rows are also present. The documented/accepted section is asserted to contain `fn[b]` and `code.rs:5`. - **Measurement:** The tests assert "zero execution" in the function rows. They assert "1/3 (33.3%); 80% target; uncovered lines: 2-3" in the file-level row. - **Explanation status:** The tests assert these statuses: - "Missing habeas:coverage proposal" - "Review missing" - "Review not accepted" with "determination is false" - "current and accepted" together with the explanation text - "No tracked justification is present." They also assert the details structure: only the permitted `
` classes appear, and there is no provenance block. Only one file is expanded per scenario. Handling several files would be the same per-row handler logic, and the text does not distinguish that case. I found no gap.
